top_signals.title: Trump Offers Xi a Helping Hand on Escalator
top_signals.summary:
Donald Trump, 80, offered Xi Jinping, 73, a hand while boarding an escalator, with Xi holding his forearm as he stepped up, during their third summit of the year in Shenzhen.

The friendly gesture contrasted with Washington’s recent efforts to restrict China’s access to key AI technology. (Source: Bloomberg)
